# Card (`card`)

Outlined panel: flat, raised or glow; header, body, footer; pressable.

Group: Data display. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/data-display';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButton` (types in `dist/web/actions/button.d.ts`): `.mh-button` with `--primary | --secondary | --tonal | --text | --danger` and `--sm | --lg`; states `.is-loading` and `:disabled`. Height follows the theme's density, corners its control radius.

```ts
export function createButton(options: ButtonOptions): ButtonHandle;

export interface ButtonOptions {
  label: string;
  variant?: ButtonVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  trailingIcon?: IconName | string;
  loading?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  type?: 'button' | 'submit' | 'reset';
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonHandle {
  el: HTMLButtonElement;
  setLabel(label: string): void;
  setLoading(loading: boolean): void;
  setDisabled(disabled: boolean): void;
}
```

`createCard` (types in `dist/web/data-display/card.d.ts`): `.mh-card`: a surface with `--mh-surface`, the panel outline, `--mh-radius-lg` and `--mh-shadow-1`. Parts `__media`, `__header` (`__icon`, `__heading` with `__eyebrow`, `__title`, `__subtitle`; `__action`), `__body`, `__footer`. Variants `--flat`, `--inset`; `--interactive` when the whole card is pressable, as a `role="button"` or, with `href`, as an `<a>`.

```ts
export function createCard(options: CardOptions = {}): CardHandle;

export interface CardOptions {
  title?: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  /** A small line above the title ("Source · 2 h ago"). */
  eyebrow?: string;
  /** Clamps the title to this many lines. */
  titleLines?: ClampLines;
  /** Small icon before the title. */
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** An element at the end of the header (an icon button, a badge, a switch). */
  headerAction?: HTMLElement;
  /** Edge-to-edge media at the top (an `<img>`), shown 16:9 and cropped to cover. */
  media?: HTMLElement;
  /** Width / height of the media (default 16 / 9); a wider one (2 or 2.4) keeps pictures short in a list or carousel. */
  mediaAspect?: number;
  /** Body content. */
  body?: Child | Child[];
  /** Footer content (usually buttons). */
  footer?: Child | Child[];
  /** `raised` (default) lifts off the canvas with `--mh-shadow-1`; `flat` has no shadow; `inset` sits in a well. */
  variant?: CardVariant;
  /** The whole card is one link (`<a href>`). Don't put other links or buttons inside. */
  href?: string;
  /** Link target; `_blank` also sets `rel="noopener noreferrer"`. */
  target?: string;
  /** The whole card is one pressable target (`role="button"`, Enter and Space); with `href`, a click listener on the link. */
  onClick?: (event: MouseEvent | KeyboardEvent) => void;
  /** Accessible name of a pressable card (default: its text). */
  label?: string;
  /** Heading level of the title (default 3). */
  headingLevel?: 2 | 3 | 4;
}

export interface CardHandle {
  el: HTMLElement;
  /** The body element, to append content later. */
  body: HTMLDivElement;
  setTitle(title: string): void;
  setSubtitle(subtitle: string): void;
}
```

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButton, createCard, createText } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const summary = createText('21.5° and 46% humidity. The blinds close at 20:00.', { tone: 'muted' });
const allOff = createButton({
  label: 'All off',
  variant: 'text',
  size: 'small',
  onClick: () => card.setSubtitle('All lights off'),
});
const open = createButton({ label: 'Open', size: 'small' });

const card = createCard({
  title: 'Living room',
  subtitle: '3 lights on',
  icon: 'home',
  body: summary,
  footer: [allOff.el, open.el],
});

document.body.append(card.el);
```

  target?: string;

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button, Card, Text } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function CardExample() {
  const [lightsOn, setLightsOn] = useState(3);
  return (
    <Card
      title="Living room"
      subtitle={lightsOn ? `${lightsOn} lights on` : 'All lights off'}
      icon="home"
      footer={
        <>
          <Button variant="text" size="small" onClick={() => setLightsOn(0)}>
            All off
          </Button>
          <Button size="small">Open</Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <Text tone="muted">21.5° and 46% humidity. The blinds close at 20:00.</Text>
    </Card>
  );
}
```
